title: fix(plugin-charts): a single-series bar chart draws one colour
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao79chBPw8FWYCAmfg8RDFpZ)_

Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25330: this is the colour half. The label half ("(None)" should read "System") stays with that card; it needs a contract decision in `@objectstack/spec`, reported on the card.

## What

Setup → System Overview → "Events by User" (one measure over the `user_id` lookup dimension) drew every bar in a different palette colour, so colour named nothing. The bar renderer in `AdvancedChartImpl` coloured each bar of a single-series bar or horizontal-bar chart by its positional palette slot.

Now a bar's colour names its series:

- A single-series bar chart draws every bar in the series colour.
- A dimension's semantic option colour (`categoryColors`, from a select field's `options[].color`, such as health green/red/yellow) still paints its own bar. A category without one takes the series colour, not a palette slot.
- Pie and donut slices are unchanged (one colour per category). A chart with two or more series is unchanged (one colour per series).

## Tests

- New pin `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.barSeriesColour-25330.test.tsx`: bar and horizontal-bar draw one fill for every bar; semantic option colours keep their bars while an unmapped category takes the series colour; two series keep one colour each.
- Ablation: with `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` reverted to the base commit, 3 of the 4 cases fail (the two-series control passes, as expected); restored, 4/4 pass.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/ packages/plugin-dashboard/` at `628a3a3`: Test Files 282 passed (282), Tests 3086 passed, 15 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts run type-check` (both `tsc` programs, the new test included): exit 0.
- `eslint` on both changed files: 0 errors. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: pass.

## Changeset

`.changeset/25330-bar-one-series-colour.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts` patch.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
